name: Oversight Capacity Gap
definition: Agent behavior exceeds the resources, expertise, or access of whoever is nominally supervising it.
trigger_conditions: Action volume exceeds what the supervisor can sample meaningfully
The supervisor lacks access to the agent's inputs or intermediate reasoning
Supervision is assigned but not resourced

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: monitoring capacity as the binding constraint on oversight

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F013 Oversight Capacity Gap. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F013
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
